kicker: FOR MEN WHO FREEZE BEFORE STARTING
title: The *3-day rule* for overthinking

label: WHY YOU FREEZE
head: You made the stakes too big
sub: "If this fails, I'm a failure." Nobody starts under that weight.

label: WHAT MOST GUYS DO
head: Commit to 3 years in their head
sub: A 3-year plan is a reason to wait for Monday.

pre: Some days you don't ask why.

head: Start your *first 3 days* tomorrow
sub: Talk to yourself again on day 4.
